product_overview: watch is a Codex-native skill for analyzing a single video source at a time and producing timestamped, evidence-grounded answers from metadata, captions, visual frames, and optional consented audio transcription. It is designed for private macOS Codex Desktop use with strict safety, authority, and cleanup controls.
core_goals: Accept exactly one supported source per request and reject ambiguous, private, playlist, live, or unsupported media.
Preflight required local tools and return typed metadata/evidence outcomes without performing later stages when not applicable.
Produce immutable, timestamped evidence with clear coverage and answerability states across metadata, transcript, and visual streams.
Support conservative caption and audio-track selection with explicit decision-required states when multiple usable tracks exist.
Enable optional, consent-gated audio transcription only after provider selection, fresh consent, and separate host network approval.
Maintain run-scoped workspace retention and explicit cleanup with refusal of unsafe deletion targets.
Provide manual repository and personal installation paths with canonical packaging and provenance documentation.

features.name: Single-source request validation and triggering
features.description: Validates that a watch request contains exactly one supported source plus optional question and controls, and refuses ambiguous or unsupported inputs before acquisition.
user_flows: POST /prepare-metadata with one valid source and optional question -> Receive 200 with validated EvidenceOutcome and current source established -> Subsequent GET /health confirms adapter availability

POST /prepare-metadata with multiple sources, a playlist URL, or an unsupported/private/live source -> Receive non-200 failure or stopped outcome indicating the request is invalid or unsupported -> No later acquisition, caption, visual, or transcription stages are performed

features.name: Metadata evidence preparation
features.description: Preflights local tools, checks source metadata and bounded subtitle availability, and returns typed immutable metadata evidence without later-stage processing when only metadata preparation is requested.
user_flows: POST /prepare-metadata with a supported source and metadata-only parameters -> Receive 200 with typed EvidenceOutcome fields tools, javascript_support, report_markdown, evidence, warnings, and coverage -> Client receives escaped Markdown report plus machine-readable evidence

POST /prepare-metadata with a supported local source and test-only header X-TestSprite-Simulate-Missing-Tool: ffprobe -> Receive a typed failed outcome whose failure.category is missing_dependency -> No media extraction or transcript upload occurs

features.name: Control and timestamp validation
features.description: Validates detail mode, focus intervals, cues, frame limits, duplicate handling, output directory, and track-selection controls with conservative failure behavior.
user_flows: POST /prepare-metadata with valid detail, focus, cues, max_frames, and keep_duplicates values within the local fixture duration -> Receive 200 with normalized controls.detail, controls.focus_start_seconds, controls.focus_end_seconds, and controls.cues_seconds numeric fields -> Metadata-only output does not claim later-stage timestamp evidence

POST /prepare-metadata with invalid detail value, malformed timestamp, negative cue, non-positive max_frames, or stale caption/audio track ID -> Receive failed or decision_required outcome describing the specific invalid control -> No selection is guessed and no later acquisition begins

features.name: Caption and audio track selection
features.description: Selects usable caption or audio tracks conservatively: explicit valid selection wins; otherwise the sole usable track may be auto-selected; multiple usable tracks require a decision_required response.
user_flows: POST /prepare-metadata with a valid explicit caption_track or audio_track ID -> Receive 200 with selected track reflected in the typed outcome and sanitized run-scoped metadata -> Processing continues only for the approved track kind within the same task

POST /prepare-metadata with multiple usable tracks and no explicit selection -> Receive decision_required outcome listing sanitized choices for the requested track kind -> Client must provide a follow-up selection before any new acquisition, extraction, or upload

features.name: Evidence stream reporting and answerability
features.description: Produces immutable evidence bundles that separate metadata, transcript, and visual streams, and reports coverage and answerability independently for user-facing conclusions.
user_flows: POST /prepare-metadata with a supported source and answer-focused request -> Receive 200 with evidence bundle including coverage, answerability, warnings, and absolute source times where applicable -> The escaped Markdown report cites provenance without conflating streams

POST /prepare-metadata when source gaps, partial subtitles, or missing visual evidence prevent a supported conclusion -> Receive partial or unsupported outcome with explicit limitations and gaps -> The response avoids fabricating transcript, frames, or completion state

features.name: Consent-gated transcription preparation
features.description: Supports optional transcription only after captions are absent or unusable, a provider is explicitly selected, fresh consent is obtained, and host network approval remains separate.
user_flows: POST /prepare-metadata for a source that needs transcription with a valid provider-selected follow-up state -> Receive consent_required or decision_required outcome naming provider, model, and track requirements -> After consent and approval, the runtime may continue with audio extraction in a later step

POST /prepare-metadata when transcription is requested but provider selection is missing, consent is declined, or host network approval is unavailable -> Receive stopped or failed outcome with truthful captions-only/frames-only fallback where possible -> No audio bytes are uploaded and no provider request is made

features.name: Workspace retention and explicit cleanup
features.description: Maintains run-owned temporary workspace state and supports only explicit, validated cleanup of the current workspace or workspace ID, refusing unsafe or unverifiable targets.
user_flows: POST /prepare-metadata with retained artifact settings and an explicit output_dir -> Receive 200 with workspace and retention state reflected in the report -> The user can later request explicit cleanup using the validated workspace identifier

POST /prepare-metadata followed by an invalid or hostile cleanup target -> Receive cleanup_refused or cleanup_deferred outcome and no files are deleted -> User paths, sibling workspaces, and unknown directories remain untouched

features.name: Manual installation, packaging, and provenance
features.description: Defines the canonical repository skill tree, manual personal symlink installation, and documentation/provenance requirements for release readiness.
user_flows: GET /health from the test-only adapter -> Receive 200 adapter status object -> Use repository documentation and canonical paths to confirm the skill package is discoverable

POST /prepare-metadata after an installation or packaging issue such as missing canonical path or refusing an existing symlink target -> Receive a typed failure or blocked outcome describing the packaging limitation -> The runtime does not self-install, self-update, or mutate global locations

tech_stack: Python standard library dataclasses and subprocess
Test-only localhost HTTP adapter for TestSprite compatibility

features.name: Watch metadata preparation
features.description: Validates exactly one watch request, preflights local tools, and returns a typed immutable metadata evidence outcome without performing later caption, visual, transcription, workspace, or cleanup stages.

endpoints.description: Test-only HTTP mapping to the production JSON stdin and stdout metadata preparation command.

body.question: string optional
body.detail: transcript or efficient or balanced or token-burner optional

test_only_headers.X-TestSprite-Simulate-Missing-Tool: ffprobe only; the test-only adapter injects an unavailable ffprobe lookup without changing PATH or installed tools

response_schema.200: Typed EvidenceOutcome with state, terminal, source, coverage, answerability, warnings, failure, evidence, tools, javascript_support, controls, and report_markdown. tools is a list of ToolStatus objects; controls uses focus_start_seconds, focus_end_seconds, and cues_seconds rather than focus and cues aliases.

endpoints.description: Test-only adapter health check; it does not exercise product behavior.

depends_on: yt-dlp and explicit source network approval for public URL metadata

known_limitations.issue: The repository is a Codex skill and command-line runtime, not an HTTP service; TestSprite reaches it through a temporary localhost adapter outside the repository.
known_limitations.impact: TestSprite results qualify the mapped request and outcome boundary, not an actual production HTTP deployment.

known_limitations.issue: Caption, visual, transcription, workspace, reuse, cleanup, installation, and live-media behavior belong to later implementation tickets.
known_limitations.impact: Those behaviors are outside this TestSprite run and cannot pass from metadata-only tests.
